Lectures

# 64GB on the card; hours of class without a laptop.
The TicNote card has 64GB (about 434 hours). A lighter TicNote recorder is also listed for meetings and lectures.

Record lectures on the card or earbuds. Transcripts and summaries land in the TicNote app. Transcription supports 120+ languages.
